## On-Call Handoff — Gateway 503s

**Status:** ONGOING (unresolved as of last log entry 03:59:27.974Z)

**Root cause:**
Gateway deploy `dep-4471` (a.novak, 02:12–02:14Z) shipped `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true` — switched the connection pool from shared/reused connections to one-per-request. Fixed pool size (20) got exhausted in under a minute.

**Impact window:**
- Start: 02:14:18.972Z — first `503` / `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`
- End: none — still failing at 03:59:27.974Z (end of available log), wait queue growing (13 → 74+)
- Scope: gateway only, all upstreams (billing, orders, catalog, accounts) hit via `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/orders`, `/v1/catalog/search`
- Workers confirmed unaffected — separate DB pool, all jobs completing normally throughout

**Error signature:**
```
ERROR pool req-XXXXX ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)
```

**Rollback target:** `dep-4471` (gateway config gen 119) — revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`.

Next: roll back dep-4471 now, this is live and worsening — want me to check if there's a rollback mechanism referenced anywhere in the repo?
